headline: Ghana Annual Inflation Rises to 11-Month High of 5.5% in October
summary: Ghana's annual inflation rate increased to an 11-month high of 5.5% in October 2026, which could influence the central bank's upcoming policy rate decision.
why: Inflation prints directly guide central bank monetary policy adjustments, which influence domestic bond yields and currency valuations.

impacts.name: Ghana
impacts.why: Higher consumer price inflation increases pressure on the central bank regarding policy rates.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
